Pork Buns
---------------------- 1.5 tbspn caster sugar 250ml warm water 1.5 teaspoon yeast tbspn veg oil 1.5 tspn baking powder 400g flower ----------------------
Sugar + water into bowl, disolve, add yeast, cover and wait 10m.
Sift in rest of stuff, mix+knead into smooth stretchy dough, cover w. towel 1h.
Split into balls, add filling if you want, steam for 20m.

Tortillas
---------------------- 2cups flour 1/2 teaspoon salt Teaspoon baking powder Tbspn lard 3/4 cups water ----------------------
Mix powders and work lard in. Add water and make dough. Knead till smooth.
Roll thin and cook in pan till golden.
